desc: Implement `back` DP table to compute max valid sequence lengths ending at each cell for all 4 diagonal directions, ensuring correct iteration order per direction.
Implement `fwd` DP tables to compute max valid continuation lengths starting at each cell, tracking expectations for next values `0` and `2` separately.
Iterate through all cells and directions to combine `back` and `fwd` lengths at potential turn points, using parity to select the correct continuation expectation.
Track and return the maximum valid segment length found, considering both straight segments and V-shaped turns.
